# Plebeian Market

> Decentralized Nostr-based e-commerce marketplace with Bitcoin Lightning payments.

Project orientation for LLMs (see https://llmstxt.org/). Cross-link: AGENTS.md (workflow rules), CLAUDE.md (architecture overview).

## Stack

Runtime/build: Bun / TypeScript / React 19
Routing: TanStack Router (file-based)
State: TanStack Store + TanStack Query
Styling: Tailwind CSS v4 + shadcn/ui
Nostr: NDK (Nostr Dev Kit) v3
Backend: Bun WebSocket server with Nostr relay integration
Testing: bun:test (unit/integration), Playwright (E2E)

## Commands

```bash
bun install                              # Install dependencies
bun dev                                  # Dev server with hot reload
bun dev:seed                             # Dev server with seed data
bun run watch-routes                     # Watch route changes (separate terminal)
bun run build                            # Build application
bun run build:production                 # Production build with minification
bun run format                           # Format code with Prettier
bun run format:check                     # Check formatting
bun run startup                          # Initialize app with default settings
bun seed                                 # Seed relay with test data
bun test:unit                            # Run unit tests
bun test:integration                     # Run integration tests
bun test:e2e                             # Run E2E tests (Playwright)
bun test:e2e:headed                      # E2E tests with visible browser
bun run dev:contextvm-server             # Start ContextVM currency server
```

## Structure (top-level)

- `src/` — Application source (components, routes, queries, lib, hooks, server)
- `src/routes/` — TanStack Router file-based routing
- `src/components/` — React components (ui/, auth/, checkout/, wallet/, etc.)
- `src/lib/stores/` — TanStack Store state management
- `src/queries/` — TanStack Query hooks and factories
- `src/server/` — Bun backend (API endpoints, ZapPurchaseManager, VanityManager)
- `e2e/` — Playwright E2E tests
- `docs/` — Feature and architecture documentation
- `deploy-simple/` — Relay and aggregator deployment infrastructure
- `contextvm/` — ContextVM currency server integration
- `scripts/` — Utility scripts (seed, startup, deployment)
- `styles/` — Global CSS (Tailwind)
